description: Land Acquisition - Walgama, Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District and amendment for the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1862/06 of 12.05.2014, Bamunakotuwa D/S Division (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including descriptions of the lands, their locations, claimants, and acquisition procedures. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
